events.name: Bash
events.head: Read T-094 and T-100 state, run the build pass grep, list vip probes

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the vip probe header, the saved 7-width evidence, and check the live links
events.input: $ sed -n 1,30p app/scripts/shoot-vip.mjs | cut -c1-220; echo ---; tail -25 workshop-plan/evidence/T-100-vip-probes-2026-10-09.txt | cut -c1-240; echo ---; for u in site/vip/ site/vip/success/ vip-before-after.png; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{size_download} $u\n" "https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/$u?v=t094b"; done; git log -1 --format='%h %cd' -- app/src/components/masterclass/vip-stack.tsx app/src/app/vip

events.name: Bash
events.head: List the seven probe widths and run the vip screenshot probe on the live mirror at three widths
events.input: $ grep -o -E '^[0-9]+px' workshop-plan/evidence/T-100-vip-probes-2026-10-09.txt | sort -un | tr '\n' ' '; grep -n -i -E '^(==|\$|node|BASE)' workshop-plan/evidence/T-100-vip-probes-2026-10-09.txt | head -8 | cut -c1-200; cd app && for w in 390 768 1440; do echo "## $w"; BASE=https://adisuja.github.io PREFIX=/tantra-workshop-live/site/vip/ WIDTH=$w node scripts/shoot-vip.mjs 2>&1 | tail -4 | cut -c1-200; done

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run the vip screenshot probe on the live mirror at the remaining four widths
events.input: $ for w in 414 1024 1280 1920; do BASE=https://adisuja.github.io PREFIX=/tantra-workshop-live/site/vip/ WIDTH=$w node scripts/shoot-vip.mjs 2>&1 | grep -c ' ok$' | tr '\n' ' '; BASE=https://adisuja.github.io PREFIX=/tantra-workshop-live/site/vip/ WIDTH=$w node scripts/shoot-vip.mjs 2>&1 | tail -1; done
